about: Conformance rows for the bento/id option G roster chain (kernel/src/roster.ts): ros. heads, the directory's rip. countersign, and member proofs. Verify each row's links with verifyRosterChain(links, { directoryKeys, rpId, origins, now, pinned }) using the values below. Match the verdict; match the reason where you can; for accepted rows, match the state (member keys are labels in `keys`). TEST KEYS ONLY.

rows.name: ok/setup
rows.about: the setup head alone: one passkey, countersigned at once

rows.name: ok/full-chain
rows.about: add a passkey, add a recovery key, the recovery key adds a consent key, a passkey removes itself at once, a reset, a passkey adds another

rows.name: ok/before-reset
rows.about: members keep the time they joined: pk1 since setup, rk1 and ck1 since their links

rows.name: ok/wait-exactly-72h
rows.about: ripened exactly 72 hours after the request

rows.name: ok/requester-clock-late
rows.about: the requester's created is 1 h before ripening, but the DIRECTORY's requestedAt is 72 h before: accepted

rows.name: ok/rk-replaced
rows.about: the recovery key replaced by a new one: one removal and one addition, both rk

rows.name: ok/remove-other-after-wait
rows.about: pk1 removes pk2, after the wait

rows.name: ok/rk-removes-itself-at-once
rows.about: a recovery key may remove itself at once too

rows.name: ok/pinned-midway
rows.about: starting from a pinned head (L2): its members carry the pin time as a lower bound

rows.name: ok/pinned-setup
rows.about: pinning the setup head keeps exact times

rows.name: ok/pinned-head-only
rows.about: a chain of just the pinned head

rows.name: ok/quarantine-carried
rows.about: an unquarantined member adds a key; the quarantined one stays marked

rows.name: ok/quarantined-removed
rows.about: the quarantined member removed after the wait

rows.name: ok/last-live-member-leaves-after-wait
rows.about: the last unquarantined member removing itself is QUEUED: accepted after the wait

rows.name: wait/last-live-member-leaves-at-once
rows.about: the last unquarantined member may not remove itself at once

rows.name: signer/quarantined
rows.about: a quarantined member may not ask for a change

rows.name: quarantine/lifted
rows.about: a member link may not lift a quarantine

rows.name: quarantine/new-member-quarantined
rows.about: a new member is never quarantined

rows.name: signer/quarantined-self-removal
rows.about: a quarantined member may not even remove itself

rows.name: quarantine/added
rows.about: a member link may not quarantine another member

rows.name: ok/sixteen-members
rows.about: a head may name 16 members

rows.name: members/seventeen
rows.about: a head may name at most 16 members

rows.name: chain/empty
rows.about: no links at all

rows.name: chain/prev-hash-wrong
rows.about: L1's prevHash names some other text

rows.name: chain/wrong-prev
rows.about: L1 names a DIFFERENT genuine setup head as its previous

rows.name: chain/seq-skip
rows.about: seq jumps from 0 to 2

rows.name: chain/seq-repeat
rows.about: seq repeats 0

rows.name: chain/address-changed
rows.about: a link names another address

rows.name: chain/no-anchor
rows.about: without a pin, the chain must start at setup

rows.name: chain/pinned-countersign-forged
rows.about: the pinned head arrives with a countersign the pinned directory key did not make

rows.name: chain/pin-mismatch
rows.about: the first link is not the pinned head

rows.name: chain/reset-replayed-elsewhere
rows.about: L6 lifted onto the chain before the reset

rows.name: order/requested-before-previous-ripened
rows.about: L2 was requested before L1 ripened: one change at a time

rows.name: wait/one-second-short
rows.about: ripened 72 h minus one second after the request

rows.name: wait/requester-clock-early
rows.about: the requester's created is 73 h before ripening but the directory's requestedAt only 1 h: refused (the wait is the directory's)

rows.name: wait/countersigned-at-request
rows.about: a change countersigned the moment it was asked for (no ripening)

rows.name: wait/remove-other-at-once
rows.about: only removing ITSELF is immediate: pk1 removing pk2 waits

rows.name: wait/add-at-once
rows.about: an addition is never immediate

rows.name: wait/reset-short
rows.about: a reset waits 72 h too

rows.name: rip/over-other-text
rows.about: the rip. names the hash of a different head

rows.name: rip/unknown-kid

rows.name: rip/wrong-key

rows.name: rip/high-s

rows.name: rip/ripened-before-requested

rows.name: rip/reset-flag-2

rows.name: rip/missing

rows.name: rip/future
rows.about: ripened more than the skew allowance after now
